title: c58 joins with focus fed-vortex: a continuous, trait-blind-mutated trait carried by the vortices, purity and repeated sweeps toward C:open-ended
summary: First loop: replace the two labels of c53's fed-vortex selection world with a label density c and trait mass z = c*theta, copied only where the vortex eats (linear in z, so the copy never reads the value), with trait-blind mutation adding a random signed step to theta in a disk; measure within-vortex trait spread, parent-daughter trait correlation, and whether the dominant trait keeps moving against the identical-draw neutral twin.
